mission: XRP intelligence and prediction-engine mastery with Barrot V3 as execution and verification foundation

ChatGPT.designed_role: Primary orchestrator, public-source research synthesis, evidence ledger, disagreement adjudication, task routing.
tested_capabilities: Current ChatGPT session can perform public web research
Current GitHub connector can inspect repository state and create commits on an existing PR branch
ChatGPT.authentication: Current product session; no external API key is exposed or stored in the repository.
ChatGPT.permissions: Current tested GitHub work was limited to an existing draft PR branch; no main-branch write, merge, secret access, workflow dispatch or deployment.
ChatGPT.fallback: Deterministic local evidence validation and cached source snapshots.

Claude.designed_role: Independent red-team review, counter-hypothesis generation, alternative causal explanations, and blind re-evaluation of evidence packets.
Claude.authentication: Separate user-authorized account/API credential required; none tested.
Claude.permissions: Read-only task packets and public evidence; no repository or trading permissions.
Claude.fallback: Local deterministic red-team checklist and second-pass source review.

Grok.designed_role: Public social-discourse and public X/YouTube claim discovery, with bot/coordination and source-quality caveats.
Grok.authentication: Separate authorized access required; none tested.
Grok.permissions: Public content only; no private messages, private accounts, deceptive access or posting authority.
Grok.fallback: Public search results and archived public discussion snapshots.

Gemini.designed_role: Independent multimodal review of public filings, diagrams, screenshots, and public YouTube videos/transcripts.
Gemini.authentication: Separate authorized account/API credential required; none tested.
Gemini.permissions: Public or explicitly authorized files only; no account or private-data access.
Gemini.fallback: Text extraction, OCR/transcript tools where lawfully available, and manual evidence review.

Copilot.designed_role: Independent repository/code review, test suggestions, and GitHub workflow/dependency review.
Copilot.authentication: GitHub/Copilot authorization required; no Copilot session or token tested.
Copilot.permissions: Read-only repository review by default; no merge, branch protection changes, secret access or workflow dispatch.
Copilot.fallback: Current GitHub connector plus deterministic static analysis and CI.

Codex.designed_role: Isolated implementation agent for bounded code changes, regression tests, and reproducible build/test artifacts.
Codex.authentication: Separate authorized Codex environment required; none tested.
Codex.permissions: Branch-scoped writes only after a task packet is approved; no main write, force-push, merge, secrets or deployment.
Codex.fallback: Current GitHub connector and local deterministic test scripts.

HuggingFace.designed_role: Public model/dataset discovery, model-card provenance, license review, benchmark retrieval, and optional inference evaluation.
HuggingFace.authentication: Public read access may be possible without a token; private or write operations require a separately scoped token; neither was tested.
HuggingFace.permissions: Public read-only discovery by default; no model upload, Space restart, private dataset access or token use.
HuggingFace.fallback: Public model cards, dataset metadata and cached artifact manifests.

Kaggle.designed_role: Public dataset discovery, reproducible historical market notebooks, and independent benchmark replication.
Kaggle.authentication: Public pages may be readable without credentials; Kaggle API/account access not tested.
Kaggle.permissions: Public datasets/notebooks only by default; no private competition data, account changes or submissions.
Kaggle.fallback: Direct public data sources and local reproducible notebooks.

Databricks.designed_role: Potential governed historical feature store, Delta snapshots, MLflow experiment tracking, model registry, drift monitoring and scalable walk-forward evaluation.
Databricks.authentication: Workspace URL, authorized identity and separately scoped token/service principal required; none tested.
Databricks.permissions: Read-only workspace/data access initially; isolated experiment schema only after authorization; no production deployment or secret-scope read.
Databricks.fallback: Local append-only JSON/Parquet snapshots, SQLite/DuckDB, Python and versioned Git artifacts.

GitHub.scope: Barrot-Agent/B-Agent repository and PR branch operations through current connected GitHub capability.
constraints: Read current main and PR state before every write
Use compare-and-swap expected head for branch updates
Write only to an explicitly selected draft PR branch
Never merge, force-push, change branch protection, dispatch workflows, access secrets or deploy without approval

task_assignments.market_structure: ChatGPT orchestrates; Claude independently red-teams causal hypotheses; Grok discovers public discussion signals; all claims require primary-source or reproducible market-data evidence.
task_assignments.filings_and_regulation: ChatGPT and Gemini independently extract filings and official rules; Claude checks legal scope and counterexamples; source text and exact section references required.
task_assignments.video_and_public_discussion: Gemini analyzes publicly available video/transcript content; Grok discovers public discussion; ChatGPT verifies channel identity and deduplicates video IDs. No exhaustive claim until channel identity and upload pagination are verified.
task_assignments.code_and_security: Copilot provides independent review if connected; Codex proposes isolated fixes if connected; ChatGPT checks exact-head GitHub metadata and CI evidence.
task_assignments.datasets_and_models: Hugging Face inventories model/data licenses and model cards; Kaggle discovers public historical datasets and baseline notebooks; Databricks is the designed feature-store/MLflow destination if authorized.
task_assignments.prediction_engine: Databricks/Kaggle/Codex roles are designed only; current implementation and verification remain in Barrot V3 repository and deterministic local scripts.

evidence_packet_schema.prohibition: Model output without a source, reproducible calculation or explicit inference label is not evidence.

data_flow: Lawful public/authorized ingestion -> immutable timestamped source snapshots and SHA-256 provenance
Canonical entity/source registry -> normalized event timeline and historical feature store
Independent platform task packets with identical data cutoff and explicit permissions
Structured evidence packets -> source-independence checks and counter-evidence collection
Adjudication by source authority, temporal validity, independence and reproducibility; never majority vote
Minority objections retained -> independent red-team -> human review for consequential decisions
Leakage-safe feature admission -> walk-forward/backtesting -> calibration/drift evaluation -> paper/shadow only
Verified handoff with artifact hashes, branch/commit SHA, exact CI run IDs and outcome follow-up

disagreement_resolution.method: Resolve each claim independently using primary-source authority, source independence, chronology, definitions, reproducibility and disconfirming evidence.
disagreement_resolution.red_team: A reviewer who did not author the claim attempts to falsify it and records the strongest counter-evidence.
disagreement_resolution.conflict_policy: If evidence remains incomparable or definitions differ, retain separate claims and block combined feature admission.

authentication_and_safety.default: Least privilege; public read-only; no shared credentials.
authentication_and_safety.secret_handling: Provider credentials only in provider-managed secret stores or authorized vaults; never in prompts, Git, public artifacts or logs.
authentication_and_safety.write_controls: No main-branch writes, force-pushes, merges, workflow dispatches, model uploads, workspace deployment, or real-money trading without explicit approval.
authentication_and_safety.rate_limits: Cache and timestamp public data; use local deterministic processing when providers are unavailable; never fabricate missing observations.
authentication_and_safety.audit: Record identity, scope, timestamp, request purpose, data returned, writes, CI results and revocation path.

connection_claim_policy: Only ChatGPT current session and GitHub repository connector are verified active. The other eight platforms are not claimed to be connected or collaborating live.
design_limitations: This is a capability and control design, not an operational integration.
No API keys, external accounts, platform agents, model endpoints or Databricks workspace were tested.
No cross-platform deliberation or handoff has occurred.
